features.note: Near-cubic charcoal box, no rack ears and no 19" face — the widest non-prop part reaches exactly the half-width (x 0.0457), so nothing projects sideways (the geometric form of this critical). REAR shot proves the DIN spring latch on the back wall; RAIL shot shows the body clipping onto a 35 mm top-hat rail that is deliberately excluded from the camera bbox (scenery, cut off at frame edges by design). Reads unmistakably as a DIN-rail device, not a 1U chassis.

PORT-DETAIL shot: 5 columns x 2 rows = 10 recessed cavities, each a real dark throat (jack recess 3.3 mm, not a painted grid) with a visible keyway tab on top and a shield. Layout matches the corrected 5x2 derivation (8 RJ45 in cols 1-4, 2 combo in col 5). Minor z-fighting shimmer on the module divider walls (see defects) but the recessed-jack read is unambiguous.

A distinct vertical column of six system-LED lenses down the LEFT of the front face, separate from the per-port link LEDs at the jacks. Default = true black; ?leds=on energises them (orange/green mix) plus the per-port bank — states are pixel-distinct and return to black. This is the cue that makes it read as a MANAGED industrial switch.

Three removable screw-terminal blocks stand proud of the TOP face (10.4 mm), with visible screw heads at 3 + 3 + 6 = 12 matching the pin counts (dual DC inputs + six-pin alarm relay). REAR shot confirms they read from behind too. No barrel jack or IEC inlet — the exact lazy failure this critical guards against is absent.

Upper front face carries a red Allen-Bradley logo patch and two white wordmark bars occupying the STRATIX 5700 silkscreen zone. Blockout-stage placeholder MASSING (flat colour blocks, no text) — correct for this pass; the surface pass replaces it with a CanvasTexture carrying the real logo + wordmark under text discipline. Reads as the manufacturer livery zone at a glance.

important_features.note: A recessed dark aperture reads at the top of the LED-column band, sitting below the face plane as a protected button rather than a printed dot. Relocated from the livery band to the mid band during build (pre-authorised refine-spec, both are confidence:low layout inferences).

A horizontal slot aperture reads on the lower-right of the front face as a real opening, distinct from the round mount-button hole above it. Position is a photo-approximation (P1: 'sin datasheet — usar aproximacion de foto'), recorded as an open item.

defects: Z-fighting / edge shimmer on the port-block module divider walls, visible in the DEFAULT and PORT-DETAIL shots — the shield faces and module walls sit close enough that Float32 depth flickers. Cosmetic at blockout massing scale; the structural pass must add explicit separation (the guards already require >= 0.1 mm overlap on attachments, but the internal divider/shield pair needs its own gap).
Livery (red logo + white bars) is placeholder block-mass, not text — carries no readable logo or wordmark yet. Intended: deferred to the surface pass by the build plan.

DIN spring-latch on the rear wall is minimal massing — it proves the clip exists and reaches behind the rear wall (z -0.0771 vs -0.0679) but has no leaf/hook form yet. Structural pass should sculpt the latch.

PORT-DETAIL framing intentionally uses its own ndc margin 0.72 (not the standard 0.94), so the standard framing probe reports it cropped=true — this is BY DESIGN to keep the jack block out from under the controls panel at 16:10, and __qaState reports the solved radius per view so it is checkable. NOT counted as a defect against the gate.
corrections: Structural pass: give the port-block shield/module-wall pair an explicit depth gap to kill the z-fighting shimmer (or offset the shield face inward past the divider).
Structural pass: sculpt the rear DIN spring-latch into a real leaf/hook form rather than a proud tab.

Surface pass: replace the livery block-mass with a CanvasTexture carrying the Allen-Bradley logo + STRATIX 5700 wordmark + catalogue number + the six LED labels, under text discipline (only P1 facts, no invented ratings).

mechanical.notes: Probe default 33 draws / 1544 tris; yaml records 38 / 1604 with LEDs energised — both far under the 150-draw / 200k-tri budget. 25 unique geometries, cache 25 (nothing bypasses the shared-geometry cache). Console clean (0 errors / 0 warnings) across all 5 captured states. Framing: default + rear fullyVisible / wellFramed / no HUD overlap; port-detail tighter-by-design.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment (not a marginal call — no blind sub-judge needed). All 5 criticals present and honestly built, all 2 importants clear, budget and console clean, states distinct and reversible. Integrity bar held: no unsourced geometry (rail is scenery and excluded from the camera solve; no fabricated text/ratings; livery correctly left as placeholder massing for the surface pass). Cleared to the structural pass — carry the 3 corrections forward.
